profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at Recharge Payments
profile.summary: Staff software engineer with over 8 years of experience designing scalable distributed systems, recently leading high-impact AI and product initiatives. Proven ability to navigate ambiguity and excel in fast-paced environments. Skilled cross-functional leader who partners closely with product management and senior leadership to deliver strategic outcomes. Passionate about driving organizational success and committed to continuous learning and growth.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Leading development of an SMS chatbot, enabling customers to manage subscriptions via natural language interactions
• Advising engineering teams on AI integration, guiding prompt engineering, model choice, and use of internal frameworks
• Built a custom agent orchestration framework for context-aware, intent-driven multi-turn conversations
• Deployed and instrumented distributed backend systems to handle high-volume traffic with third-party integrations
• Developed internal tools to evaluate and refine LLM prompts, accelerating experimentation across engineering teams

positions.title: Staff Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Led an R&D team to launch new products across key initiatives including Failed Payment Recovery, A/B testing for Flows, email analytics, and memberships
• Collaborated across teams to deliver projects, triage complex issues, and participate in architectural and design reviews
• Drove the team roadmap in partnership with product and leadership, strategically assigning projects to support engineer growth and career development
• Designed technical interview process for backend software engineers in the R&D organization

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Led a team of seven engineers developing the Memberships product using Python and Flask. Drove the adoption of agile practices resulting in improved team productivity and timely delivery of project milestones
• Conducted research and implemented proof-of-concepts to explore potential features, worked alongside product management to identify key features and designs that align with organizational goals
• Partnered with the CTO on high-impact projects including new features, tech debt reduction, and refactoring efforts aimed at improving efficiency and scalability across the engineering organization
• Played a key role in critical project to implement multiple payment methods within high-risk charge processing services

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a distributed web crawling framework in Python and Django that supports over 100 million monthly requests
• Refactored message broker backend from using SQL to Amazon SQS to achieve 10x increase in max load handling
• Implemented and maintained AWS resources including EC2, RDS, and S3
• Design and developed cost saving solution to automatically disable underutilized AWS resources
• Managed and executed tasks to integrate business goals of internal and external clients into products
• Managed team responsibilities and tasks and coordinating weekly progress with upper management
• Mentored and trained junior engineers and new hires, facilitating knowledge transfer and improving code quality

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed REST API endpoints using Django REST, enabling clients to integrate with external systems
• Created user interfaces through Bootstrap, jQuery, and Javascript
• Reverse engineered websites to extract open-source data from APIs, web pages, and other sources
• Developed and improved existing features of an in-house crawling framework
• Wrote custom analysis reports in SQL and Python to fit business needs of clients

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
•	Developed a desktop application with Python, PyQt, and SQLAlchemy streamlining the mapping of external insurance agency data to internal systems
•	Designed SQL tables to effectively handle and manage insurance agency and policy data from multiple data providers
•	Created standardized workflows using Python, SQL, and Excel to improve data ingestion and storage processes, leading to increased team productivity by removing manual steps
•	Led team’s transition from collecting data through PDFs and paper to quicker electronic alternatives
•	Created Python tools to reduce repetitive tasks and improve overall efficiency
•	Analyzed employee, financial, and policy data of various insurance agencies to create benchmarking reports
•	Consulted clients on best practices regarding agency management systems
•	Traveled to clients to consult and set up data collection process
•	Assisted in research for yearly financial outlook studies, client presentations, and product improvement
•	Wrote occasional Metric of the Month excerpts for monthly magazine

positions.title: Audit Associate
positions.description:
•	Analyzed large sets of data with Python, SQL, Excel, Access to create user-friendly reports for managers and team
•	Created programs and scripts in Python to increase efficiency of work for all team members 
•	Reviewed and reconciled financial and accounting statements for accuracy and completeness
•	Worked alongside team to conduct unclaimed property audit examinations of various corporations
•	Traveled to perform on-site review of financial and accounting documents
•	Tracked progress of assigned audit examinations and relayed deadlines, issues, and progress to managers
•	Consulted on documentation and data received from corporations for analyzing information quickly and accurately
•	Specialized in stored value card and insurance examinations

positions.title: Head Teaching Assistant for Financial Modeling
positions.description:
•	Led weekly discussions on modeling to help students better understand the integration between Excel and finance
•	Managed team of six undergraduate teaching assistants for two courses
•	Worked closely alongside the professor to help create lesson plans and advise on student progress
•	Tutored students individually on challenging financial modeling concepts and projects
•	Explained and graded major financial modeling projects
•	Administered exams, quizzes, and weekly lab work

company.name: Isenberg School of Management, UMass Amherst

positions.title: Grader: Computer Science
positions.description:
•	Coordinated with others to grade assignments for computer science courses
•	Helped students with their assignments and technical problems
•	Organized and input data for professor to better determine their grading system

positions.title: Crew
positions.description:
•	Prepare and complete food orders in a timely and accurate fashion
•	Maintain store front and carry out closing duties
•	Work with other team members to provide an excellent customer experience

projects.title: nba_api
projects.description:
Python client library for NBA.com APIs
• Reverse-engineered NBA.com APIs by developing an automated tool to extract and document endpoints
• 2,900+ stars and 600+ forks on GitHub and 700,000+ downloads on PyPI, demonstrating strong community adoption

projects.title: Swar's Chia Plot Manager
projects.description: A plot manager for Chia plotting. Over 1300 stars and 425 forks.
